# v3 numbers (generated by v3_fixes.py; reproduce with `python3 v3_fixes.py` from x3/)

Conventions: eligible = relevant test record (label 1). Frozen per-review tau from runs/jev/dev_tau.union.json; caught = p >= tau. WSS@95 = (TN+FN)/N - 0.05 (oracle stop unless stated). Stored numbers are 3-dp rounded; tolerance 0.0005.

## Cross-check status
53/53 PASS. No discrepancies.

## F7 Clopper-Pearson 95% CIs on per-review recall (frozen tau, 39 reviews)
- Reviews reaching 0.95: 25/39; below: 14.
- Of the 14 below-target reviews, 13 have a CP upper bound at or above 0.95, so their shortfall is not statistically established.
- Of the 25 reviews at or above 0.95, 24 have a CP lower bound below 0.95.
- Median CP half-width 0.168; worst review Moseng_2024 at recall 0.714.
- Sentence: "Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals on per-review recall at the frozen threshold have median half-width 0.17; 13 of the 14 reviews below 0.95 have intervals that include 0.95, so per-review shortfalls are point estimates."

## F9 absolute reads per arm (median review; 39 reviews)
- Median dev labels 1006; median test records 292.
- Judge, oracle stop (records read in ranked order until 95% recall; the WSS basis): 61 test reads; with 1006 dev labels = 1067.
- Judge, frozen per-review threshold (every record with p >= tau is read; records below tau are auto-excluded): 61 test reads (share 0.265); with 1006 dev labels = 1067. The two medians coincide at 61; per review they differ.
- ASReview test-only: 118 test reads, 0 dev reads used (net WSS still charges n_dev).
- ASReview full pool: 386 reads of 1679 records; test-scored from the full order: 375 reads.
- Worked 2,000-record review (60/20/20, median share): judge 1283 = 1200 dev + 83 test; ASReview test-only 167 test reads; ASReview full pool 521 reads.
- Net WSS (both arms charged n_dev): judge 0.1300 at full precision (0.1299 in results_net_effort.json from 3-dp WSS), ASReview u4 0.0815.
- Sentence: "Each arm's cost is in absolute reads: the judge reads 1067 records for the median review, of which 1006 are development labels; the net-effort gap shrinks mechanically because both arms are charged the same development reads, and the comparison charges ASReview development reads it does not use."

## F10 tie sensitivity and 27 / 29 / 50 reconciliation
- Per-review tau, include if p >= tau: 27 missed of 577 eligible; 14 reviews below 0.95.
- Per-review tau, include only if p > tau (ties excluded): 41 missed; 17 reviews below 0.95.
- Fixed global 0.07, include if p >= 0.07: 29 missed.
- LOO-derived global tau (per-review, from results_gaps39.json): 50 missed; tau values {0.06: 3, 0.07: 35, 0.21: 1}.
- Records exactly at per-review tau: 418; exactly at 0.07: 803.
- Reviews reaching 0.95: per-review tau 25/39; fixed global 0.07 35/39; LOO global tau 35/39.
- 27 = per-review threshold. 29 = fixed global 0.07. 50 = LOO-derived global tau (gap_tests.py: each review's global tau fit on the pooled dev records of the other 38 reviews). The LOO figure is the one matching the paper's 50/577.
- DISCREPANCY vs D3: D3 attributes 50/577 to the label-free global threshold 0.07. The fixed 0.07 threshold misses 29/577; 50 belongs to the LOO global tau. Both reach 35/39 reviews. Use the threshold name explicitly.

## MDE (80% power, two-sided alpha 0.05, normal approximation, paired by review)
Assumptions: reviews independent; observed paired SD of per-review WSS@95 differences; mean-based MDE = (1.960+0.842) x SD / sqrt(n); median-based MDE approximated by the mean MDE x sqrt(pi/2) = 1.2533 (normal asymptotics).
- SYNERGY judge-ASReview test-only, n=39: MDE mean 0.0993; median (approx) 0.1244.
- SYNERGY judge-ASReview from-full, n=39: MDE mean 0.0850; median (approx) 0.1066.
- External judge-u4, n=22: MDE mean 0.0594; median (approx) 0.0745.
- Sentence: "At 80% power the comparison could detect a paired median gap of about 0.074 in the external set and 0.124 in SYNERGY; smaller gaps are not excluded."
